description: Om Freight Forwarders Limited provides logistics and allied services through sea, road, rail, and air in India. It offers customs clearance; international air and sea freight forwarding; charter services; project logistics; nominated cargo; bonded trucking and trans shipping; port and vessel handling; road transportation; inventory warehousing and distribution; third country export cross trade; post shipment activities; export import DGFT licensing; and value added services. Om Freight Forwarders Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
